statements.statement: The patient presents with recurrent episodes of unexplained syncope and transient neurological deficits suggestive of transient cerebral ischemic attacks
Diagnosis codes are R55 and G45.9
The procedure code billed is CPT 93247
The service is a long-term continuous ECG monitoring study
The service is ordered to evaluate for potential arrhythmic etiologies contributing to the patient's intermittent symptoms
The claim was denied because the time limit for filing has expired
